pick.name: UptimeRobot Free
pick.why: Pricing page explicitly says free is 'Good for personal and commercial projects'
pick.free_limits: 50 monitors, 5-min interval, 1 basic status page, email alerts (SMS/voice credits extra), 5 integrations

alts.name: Uptime Kuma (self-host)
alts.why: Unlimited, 20-second checks, on a box that is NOT your prod
alts.windows_fit: Docker on VM; Windows native possible

alts.name: Better Stack Free
alts.free_limits: 10 monitors, 1 status page, 3 GB logs (3-day), 100k exceptions; labelled 'Free for personal projects'

candidates.name: Upptime
candidates.verdict: GitHub-Actions status page; last tagged release 2020 (template still used)

candidates.name: OpenStatus
candidates.verdict: AGPL-3.0, hosted free tier not checked

decision: UptimeRobot is the only hosted option whose page explicitly allows commercial use on free. Run Uptime Kuma later if you need faster checks or more status pages.

verify.note: UptimeRobot Free: 50 monitors, 5-min checks, 1 basic status page, 5 integrations, 'Good for personal and commercial projects'. Better Stack alt: 'Free for personal projects', 10 monitors, 3 GB logs/3 days, 100k exceptions. Both confirmed.
